source.title_or_context: Recommendations for evaluation of sudden death victims Investigation of unexpected SD, especially in case of suspicion of inherited disease, should be made a public health priority. I B In cases of SD, it is recommended to collect a detailed description of circumstances of death, symptoms prior to death, the family history, and to review prior medical files.
